# Roger Li

> Software engineer based in Brooklyn, NY, open to remote. This site is Roger's resume/portfolio.

Roger started in bioengineering research, moved into software engineering, spent a few years in product management, and then returned to engineering. The product years mean roadmap and client conversations are familiar ground.

## Structured data

- [Resume (JSON Resume schema)](/resume.json): full work history, education, and skills in machine-readable form.

## Sections on this page

- About: who Roger is, current focus, location.
- Experience: work history, most recent first — Senior Software Engineer (2023–present), with prior roles at Jumbo, VidMob, Epic Systems, and earlier bioengineering work.
- Skills: languages/frameworks, tooling, and API integration experience.
- Projects: selected project work.
- Working with AI: how Roger uses AI in his engineering workflow. Three to five parallel Claude Code sessions on separate git worktrees, custom skills that keep an issue/worktree/branch/PR linked as one unit of work, and scheduled routines that clean up stale worktrees and sessions. This site was built with Claude Code.
- Contact: how to reach Roger.
